heading: Monday, March 23, 2026
topLine: Mistral releases Voxtral TTS text-to-speech model.

items.headline: Mistral releases Voxtral TTS text-to-speech model
items.summary: Voxtral TTS is a 4B-parameter text-to-speech model supporting nine languages and voice adaptation from about 3 seconds of reference audio, with open weights under the non-commercial CC BY-NC 4.0 license. Mistral reports human raters preferred it over ElevenLabs Flash v2.5 for naturalness.
